title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 internal checkpoints Ember Alpha and Beacon Alpha
summary: OpenAI is reportedly testing internal GPT-5.6 checkpoints under the codenames Ember Alpha and Beacon Alpha, with a possible public release around mid-June. Sources point to a longer red-teaming and safety evaluation cycle than for prior 2025 releases.

research.notes: Internal testing reports from credible developers on X; no formal OpenAI announcement.
